title: When a widget pops up from a auto-hide panel, there's a gap between the two during the animation
line: Popups opened from a hidden auto-hide panel now slide in attached to the panel instead of leaving a gap while it appears.
explanation: Opening a popup such as Kickoff with its shortcut while the auto-hide panel is hidden starts two independent KWin slide animations: the panel slides in from the screen edge, while the popup slides out from the line where the panel's top edge will end up. For the first frames the popup was therefore drawn above an empty strip where the panel had not arrived yet. The sliding popups effect now finds a panel that is sliding in from the same edge and covers the popup's slide line, and adds that panel's current slide offset to the popup's own position and clip line, so the popup moves together with the panel (also when both slide out). Popups of panels that are not animating are unchanged.

commits.message:
plugins/slidingpopups: let popups follow a panel sliding in

When a popup opened from a hidden auto-hide panel, it slid in from the
panel's final position while the panel was still sliding in, leaving a
gap between them. Such popups now move along with the panel's slide.

BUG: 470102

media.caption: Master, Alt+F1 with a hidden auto-hide panel, four consecutive frames: Kickoff appears while the panel is still missing below it
With the fix, same steps: Kickoff stays right on top of the panel in every frame
Master, the open and close animation slowed down 4x
With the fix, slowed down 4x: popup and panel move together when opening and closing
